V59 therefore retains the newer two-phase authority pattern: a pre-call launch descriptor freezes only pre-call facts, and a post-call executor observation binds that exact launch descriptor to the already-existing source-bound model-call/output/ABI receipt identities. Earlier one-phase gates remain provenance/donor material only. No provider/model/training execution is performed and no promotion credit is minted.
